in_sanskrit.name: Vanlal
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Bringer of good fortune
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Vanlal एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Vanlal is derived from the Sanskrit language and is composed of two parts. The first part, 'Van', means 'forest' or 'jungle'. The second part, 'Lal', means 'good fortune'. Thus, the name Vanlal signifies someone who brings good fortune from the forest or jungle.
